location_exception_reason: Poultry farming is geographically concentrated in specific Indian belts (Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, Bihar). Regional origin and local integrator network availability (ABIS, Suguna, Venky's operate regionally) materially affect buyer sourcing decisions and shed suitability; location in title aids buyer discovery of region-appropriate suppliers.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Fabricator) are redundant in poultry shed titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product meaning intact—the shed itself is the product, not the business relationship.
